description: 50 news and media outlets for each of the 30 largest economies by projected 2026 nominal GDP
gdp_metric: IMF WEO NGDPD, 2026, billions of US dollars
selection_method: Countries are ordered by IMF 2026 nominal GDP. Each country's SCImago 2026 Spring outlets are ordered by global rank. Where SCImago has fewer than 50, remaining places come from the Wikidata-based Media Directory, prioritizing confirmed websites, then news outlets, magazines, broadcasters, and radio, and sorting within each category group by directory reach score. Different source scores are not comparable.
